title: Signed co-area identity on bands {a < f < b} and integrability of the slice density (Simon Ch. 6, Remark 4.2; parent Step 4)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ and ν be measures on ℝ^P, and let M ⊆ ℝ^P. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and g : ℝ^P → ℝ be Borel, with x ↦ |G(x)|·g(x) integrable for μ⌞M. Assume the co-area identity (CA): for every Borel h : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} h dν is Lebesgue-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} h dν dt = ∫_M |G| h dμ (integrals against restricted measures). Let φ(t) := ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} g dν be the Bochner integral against ν⌞(M ∩ f⁻¹{t}), which is 0 if g is not integrable there. Then φ is Lebesgue-integrable on ℝ, and for all a, b ∈ ℝ, ∫_{M∩f⁻¹((a,b))} |G| g dμ = ∫_{(a,b)} φ(t) dt.
